Enhance with AI: Simplify, and a stretch of one hand

Implementation 04, Phase 4. Simplify goes over the whole song, batch after batch, with the rules of simplicity only (uniform patterns, no quick jumps); the hands do not move. Each batch sees every change made before it, so a passage that repeats gets the same change. Each passage shows the sheet before (the My library version) and after (a test copy, deleted after); the band marks the notes that changed. Under it, the AI's own words for each change.

  1. A stretch of one hand
  2. 7 Years (4 passages)
  3. Moonlight Shadow (11 passages)

A stretch of the left hand

7 Years, 2:59.88 to 3:04.12, the left hand only, with the words Make the octaves single notes. (an in-memory test: nothing was written). The other hand stays exactly as it is. 15 notes left out. Drawn with the figures of the rule; the app also keeps the figures the AI wrote, so a figure or two may differ on the page.

7 Years, passage 2: 2:09.56

A decision for you: here the AI changed a note's name (La 3 became Fa 3). The four other times this chorus plays (1:13.56, 1:21.56, 1:29.56, 1:37.56) the left hand has La 2 + Fa 3 at this place, so the AI made this one match them. The prompt says never to change a note's name, and the check did not stop it.
